profile.clock: runtime.now() = 1700000000000 + round(world.state.serverTime): declared and deterministic; epoch fields are not normalized

records.name: bot-client-net
scenario: three players: two humans and one bot (botTag tier easy / persona farmer, build.commit null)
one client perf sample, one drop and one reconnect on p0
p0 kills p1, then the bot; the run ends

records.name: death-terrain-sudden
scenario: three humans; p1 dies to arena terrain damage, then p2 to sudden-death damage; p0 is last standing
covers DeathCause terrain and suddenDeath kinds plus firstBlood

records.name: death-quit
scenario: two humans; p1 leaves mid-run (removePlayer -> mia), the recorder classifies the death kind quit and the run ends
covers DeathCause quit, quit true and PlayerOutcome mia

records.name: draw-both-down
scenario: two humans die in the same tick to arena damage: the run ends in a draw

records.name: void-null-nullables
scenario: two humans, one contact opens a duel, the room voids the run before anyone dies
covers end void, PlayerOutcome alive, null firstBlood/death/pids, and a duel closed by runEnd with comeback null

records.name: abandoned-end
scenario: two humans, the room disposes of the run mid-run: end abandoned with both players still alive

records.name: long-run-snapshots-tiles-afk
scenario: two humans stand for 1805 simulated seconds, then p0 kills p1
covers power snapshots at minutes 1/3/5/10, non-empty tiles, afk/afkMs true, truncated.samples and a long duration

records.name: offers-truncated
scenario: two humans, 260 stat-chest offers in one run (the recorder keeps 256)
covers truncated.offers and a full offers array

records.name: duels-truncated
scenario: two humans, 258 disengage duel segments (the recorder keeps 256)
covers truncated.duels and a full duels array

records.name: planning-mia
scenario: three humans enter planning (planSeconds 0.5); p2 leaves during planning
covers planningMia and a two-player run after the planning departure

records.name: win-bonus-opponents
scenario: three human starters; p0 wins without damaging anyone (p1 killed p2, then terrain killed p1)
covers winBonusWithheld true with winBonusWhy opponents (the base record covers starters)

blockers.reason: the recorder classifies them from live regional-mob and Plague-zombie roster sources; this harness drives the hand-built no-mob rig world (same reason the existing base record has no mob section).
camp clears need a generated camp arena with spawn rosters and credited mob kills (a real camp fight); the declared hand-built arena has no camps or mobs. Follow-up A owns the producer arena.

requires a serialized record over TELEMETRY_RECORD_MAX_BYTES (512 KiB) so the sink retries without tiles; the captured variants are far below that (the 1800-sample tiles are ~6 KiB), and reaching it honestly would need a deliberately huge camp/offer/duel run outside this bounded packet.
